purpose: Agent framework for building autonomous actors with lifecycle management, status tracking, and graceful shutdown.

patterns.name: Agent lifecycle
patterns.description: Agents have managed lifecycle with init, validate, run, and shutdown hooks.

patterns.name: Agent status
patterns.description: Built-in status tracking (idle, initializing, running, error, shutdown).

pitfalls: Agents automatically handle SIGTERM/SIGINT for graceful shutdown
Override onValidate() to prevent run() if preconditions aren't met
Agent state is persisted to database via SmrtObject inheritance
